description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the GetRealPersonVerificationResult operation for querying real-person verification results on mobile devices
description_zh: 本文介绍核身认证移动端查询GetRealPersonVerificationResult的语法及示例
name: GetRealPersonVerificationResult

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the trusted real-person verification.

A VerificationToken that has already been verified cannot be queried again. Otherwise, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
可信核身认证的唯一标识。

已认证通过的VerificationToken不能做二次查询校验，否则会报错
parameters.name: verification_token
